blocks.html: Autonomous transport robots designed to automate the movement of heavy materials, inventory, equipment, and supplies across industrial, commercial, and healthcare environments. By reducing manual handling and streamlining internal logistics, these intelligent robots improve operational efficiency while ensuring safe and reliable material transportation.

items.title: Intelligent Navigation
text: Advanced LiDAR and vision-based navigation enable reliable movement through dynamic environments while avoiding obstacles in real time.

items.title: High Payload Capacity
text: Transport heavy goods, equipment, and materials safely and efficiently across large facilities with minimal human intervention.

items.title: Continuous Operation
text: Flexible charging options and battery management support continuous operation for demanding logistics workflows.

items.title: Safe Material Handling
text: Multiple safety systems, intelligent obstacle detection, and emergency protection ensure secure operation around personnel and equipment.

blocks.html: Smarter Internal Logistics Through Intelligent Automation

Heavy-load transport robots automate repetitive material handling tasks, allowing organizations to improve productivity while reducing manual labour and operational risks. Designed for warehouses, factories, hospitals, and commercial facilities, these robots transport inventory, tools, equipment, and supplies safely and consistently throughout the day.

With intelligent navigation, autonomous route planning, and centralized fleet management, heavy-load robots help optimize internal logistics while supporting modern automation strategies.

The KEENON S100 is one of the flagship heavy-load autonomous transport robots within our industrial robotics portfolio. Designed for demanding commercial and industrial environments, it combines high payload capacity, intelligent navigation, advanced safety systems, and flexible charging options to automate internal material transportation efficiently. Its modular platform also supports customised shelves and transport configurations for different operational requirements.
